text: 中办、国办：鼓励国有企业加快建立独立核算、免于增值保值考核、容错纠错的研发准备金制度
text_en: General Offices of the CPC Central Committee and State Council: Encourage state-owned enterprises to accelerate the establishment of R&D reserve funds with independent accounting, exemption from value-preservation and appreciation assessments, and error tolerance and correction
